description: Cite and manage bibliography from Zotero via JSON-RPC
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: This extension reads and writes bibliography files and contacts configured Zotero endpoints.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: Supports bibliography files provided by virtual file systems, including Overleaf Workshop.

command.citeSmart.title: Zotero Cite: Cite + Bibliography
command.exportBibLatex.title: Zotero Cite: Export BibLaTeX

command.citeBibliography.title: Zotero Cite: Cite and Create Bibliography for Pandoc/LaTeX
command.citeMarkdownBibliography.title: Zotero Cite: Cite and Create Bibliography for Markdown

configuration.title: Zotero Cite
configuration.bibliograpyStyle.descripti: URL of bibliography style, see: https://www.zotero.org/styles
configuration.defaultBibName.description: Explicit bibliography path override. When unset, LaTeX bibliography commands are detected automatically; otherwise ref.bib is used. Supports placeholders like ${workspaceFolder}, ${fileBasename}, ${fileBasenameNoExtension}, ${fileDirname}, ${fileExtname}
configuration.latexBibStyle.description: LaTeX bibliography style: bibtex or biblatex
configuration.latexCitationCommand.descr: LaTeX citation command name without the leading backslash, for example cite, citet, citep
configuration.excludedBibFields.descript: Exclude these fields from BibTeX content fetched from Zotero (for example: file, annotation)
configuration.minimizeZotero.description: Any non-empty value minimizes the Zotero window after citation
configuration.bibtexSource.description: Select the provider used for BibTeX written to bibliography files. Item selection still uses Better BibTeX CAYW.
configuration.bibtexSource.zoteroInspire: Fetch BibTeX strictly from INSPIRE-HEP through zotero-inspire
configuration.zoteroInspireBibtexUrl.des: Loopback zotero-inspire read-only BibTeX endpoint. The path must be /connector/zinspireBibtex.
configuration.statusMessageDuration.desc: Status bar message duration in milliseconds
configuration.showCommandPickerInStatusB: Show Zotero command picker button in the status bar
configuration.showMarkdownCitationHoverP: Show Markdown citation hover preview for [^key] and @key
configuration.showMarkdownCitationComple: Show Markdown citation completion suggestions for [^ and @
